description_en: Deletes department information that has been maintained in Alibaba Business Travel
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可删除已经维护在阿里商旅的部门信息
name: DeleteDepartment

parameters.help_en:
The custom department ID defined by the enterprise.
Ensure this parameter is correct. Otherwise, the wrong department may be deleted
parameters.help_zh:
企业自定义部门 ID。
请确保本参数无误，否则会出现误删的情况
parameters.name: out_dept_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling the operation over HTTP, this parameter must be included in the request URL. For information about how to obtain it, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending the token, you can use any of the following formats: `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. We recommend using `corp_token=value`
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of this request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
